description: Create a free AI website draft (Korean + English, multi-page, mobile-first) from an existing site URL and/or a short description. Takes 30–90 seconds. Returns previewUrl (open it), claimUrl (the user signs in there to own and edit the draft — free, no card), pages, and what still needs the owner (photos, prices). Max 3 per hour per caller.

kind.description: What the business does, e.g. "cafe", "pilates studio", "dental clinic", "app"

menu.description: Key items with prices, one per line, e.g. "Latte 5,500원" (optional, only real ones)

notes.description: Anything the owner said: mood, colors (#hex ok), who the customers are, phone, KakaoTalk channel URL (optional)

url.description: Existing website to migrate (optional if name+kind given)

name: gyeol_make_draft
